about: Recommended inputs for the hand of "Shape, by gradient descent" (RA research redo, 2026-11-09). Keys follow deck/tools/gd/hand.py and trials.py. Nothing in deck/ was changed. Findings and reasons: hand-at-rest.md; sizes for the drawing: hand-sizes.json; the thumb before and after: hand-variant.json.

ANSUR.source: ANSUR II men, public CSV recomputed (scripts/ansur_check.py); NATICK/TR-15/007 dimensions (44), (65), (42)
ANSUR.definitions: hand: stylion to the middle fingertip; palm: stylion to the centre of the crease at the base of the middle finger; breadth: metacarpale II to metacarpale V

BONES_RAW.source: A. Buryanov and V. Kotiuk, Proportions of Hand Segments, Int. J. Morphol. 28(3):755-758 (2010), Table I; X-rays of adults aged 19 to 78, right hands, lengths between joint surfaces

WEB.change: the recorded values are per cent of the finger from the web to the skin's tip (Table III), not mm; in mm as given here (derived, scripts/sizes.py). Recommended: do not use WEB for SCALE or KNUCKLE_BACK.

SCALE.change: none in size; the derivation is replaced
SCALE.source: three routes in scripts/sizes.py: stylion to fingertip = carpus (about 26 mm, estimate) + metacarpal + bones + tip: 1.066 (1.047 to 1.085); Greiner 1991 digit 3 length over this sample's: 1.047; crease-based: 0.99 to 1.12

CASCADE.condition: relaxed, on the ground; forearm neutral; means over four arm positions with the elbow straight (shoulder flexed 0, 45, 90, 135 deg); wrist from 16 deg extended to 24 deg flexed (mean 10 deg flexed)
CASCADE.source: K.-S. Lee and M.-C. Jung, Int. J. Occupational Safety and Ergonomics 20(1):91-101 (2014), Tables 4 to 7
CASCADE.notes: Skin markers read finger knuckles about 4 to 5 deg high (Cook et al. 2007). The paper does not state that each angle is measured from the bone before; the values behave so.

sources.cmc: K.-S. Lee and M.-C. Jung, Int. J. Occupational Safety and Ergonomics 20(1):91-101 (2014), Table 3: 45 (SD 12); what it is measured from is not stated; not used by the model
sources.mcp_39: K.-S. Lee and M.-C. Jung, Int. J. Occupational Safety and Ergonomics 20(1):91-101 (2014), Table 3: 39 (SD 12), skin markers, reference not defined (measured)
sources.mcp_25: estimate: 39 less a marker over-read of 6 to 24 deg
sources.mcp_12.5: W. P. Cooney III et al., J. Bone Joint Surg. 63-A(9):1371-1381 (1981): the rest position is described with knuckle and tip joint each flexed 10 to 15 deg (described, not measured)
sources.ip: K.-S. Lee and M.-C. Jung, Int. J. Occupational Safety and Ergonomics 20(1):91-101 (2014), Table 3: 10 (SD 6); Rogers et al. 2008, Table 4: 6 (SD 15) and 17 (SD 16)

ORBIT_FINGER_FLEX.status: verified, reads 2; the angle is not defined in the report

KNUCKLE_BACK.source: one specimen (Goislard de Monsabert et al. 2018, ESM Table S3, scaled): 0.8 / 4.7 / 13.4; MyoHand model: -1.3 / 3.0 / 12.8; Greiner 1991 heights less Buryanov's fingers (derived): 0.7 / 7.4 / 18.9 (scripts/sizes.py)
KNUCKLE_BACK.status: replaced (the old values came from the web heights read as mm)
KNUCKLE_BACK.effect: pinky 3.8 mm further back in both placements

PALM_SKIN.source: bounded by hand thickness at the middle knuckle, 32.9 mm (SD 2.0), Garrett 1970 (AMRL-TR-69-42), dimension 8: the skin is 16 to 19 mm under that joint's centre
PALM_SKIN.effect: the hump grip moves 2.6 mm along the mouse per mm

THUMB_CMC_BACK.source: Goislard de Monsabert et al. 2018, ESM Table S3 (one specimen, hand 203 mm; its own measurements, not Veeger 1997): 56.0 mm; MyoHand model: 58.0 mm (hand about 185 to 190 mm)

THUMB_CMC_RADIAL.source: the same two: 2.6 and 8.1 mm toward the thumb side of the index knuckle
THUMB_CMC_RADIAL.status: two sources; not an input of hand.py (the drawing uses it)

THUMB_BONES.source: links between joint centres: base to knuckle 38.6 (the specimen) and 35.9 (MyoHand); knuckle to tip joint: Buryanov's 31.57 x 1.052 + about 2; tip joint to the bone's tip: 21.67 x 1.052 + about 3
THUMB_BONES.status: first link two sources; the others derived

CONTACT_Y.source: estimate; the Sora's side buttons start at y 16.4 (front) and 19.6 (rear) (scripts/glb_nodes.py), so the band 12 to 18 lies under them

GRIP_HEEL_DEG.change: state as an assumption and rerun at 20 to 30
GRIP_HEEL_DEG.effect: about 3 mm of fingertip travel per degree

lifted_anchor_index_tip_z.status: an artefact of the solver's starting guess [-25, 85] (scripts/audit_hand.py)
lifted_anchor_index_tip_z.effect: thumb 13 mm and each slide 10 mm per 10 mm

fingertip_x.measured: index pad to middle pad about 21 mm (SD 3) with the fingers together, holding a mouse (Rogers et al. 2008); the Sora's buttons centre at x +/- 14.7

HANDS.note: hand length only: one SD of posture moves the fingertips 9 to 12 mm, one SD of hand length 3 mm

thumb_axes_distal_radial_palmar.status: verified figures (reads 2; model file); two sources disagree by about 40 deg on the abduction axis

tip_ahead_of_index_knuckle_mm.source: derived (scripts/rest_pose.py) from Rogers et al. 2008: thumb pad centre to index pad centre 60.1 mm (SD 10.6), hands of 178.1 mm
